source.author: verg
source.text: Illi me comitem et consanguinitate propinquum pauper in arma pater primis huc misit ab annis, dum stabat regno incolumis regumque vigebat consiliis, et nos aliquod nomenque decusque gessimus.
source.text_original: Illi me comitem et consanguinitate propinquum / pauper in arma pater primis huc misit ab annis, / dum stabat regno incolumis regumque vigebat / consiliis, et nos aliquod nomenque decusque / gessimus.
source.text_english: My poor father sent me here as his companion and near kinsman to arms, from my earliest years, while he stood unharmed in his kingdom and flourished in the councils of kings, and I had borne some share of name and honor.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Haemoniam primis Pelias frenabat ab annis, iam gravis et longus populis metus: illius amnes Ionium quicumque petunt, ille Othryn et Haemum atque imum felix versabat vomere Olympum.
reuse.text_original: Haemoniam primis Pelias frenabat ab annis, / iam gravis et longus populis metus: illius amnes / Ionium quicumque petunt, ille Othryn et Haemum / atque imum felix versabat vomere Olympum.
reuse.text_english: From his earliest years Pelias was restraining Haemonia, now a heavy and long-standing fear to the peoples: for all its rivers that seek the Ionian Sea, he ploughed Othrys and Haemus and even the lowliest slopes of Olympus with his happy plow.
